events.text: Jamie’s caregiver account is already open.
The shared note arrives without refreshing the page.
Her own words and when it happened stay together.
Mei can ask Jamie for practical help.
Jamie acknowledges the request. Mei knows it has been seen.
After the call, Jamie records what they agreed.
Checked medication instructions and schedules stay together.
Bring the relevant care history to the next appointment.
Review the draft. Every item keeps its source.
Share a read-only copy after your review.
